en.peak.slogan: Lunch break is peak, run big jobs now!
en.preview.body: For desktop and tablet: at 1024px and wider the panel becomes a centred dialog with a two-column card grid, at 768-1023px a centred 560px sheet. Phones and phone-landscape keep the original layout. Preview builds update only within the preview branch, never to the stable release.
en.preview.title: Pre-release build — not a stable release
en.settings.alertChannelBridge: App bridge available — a notification when the app is in the background, an in-app toast while you're inside the app
en.settings.alertChannelIdle: No alert has fired yet — the channel is confirmed on the first alert
en.settings.alertChannelNone: Alerts cannot be delivered — no notification channel on this platform (only the mobile DSHA provides one); balances just turn red on the dashboard
en.settings.alertDeliveryToast: in-app toast (the app was in the foreground)
en.settings.alertPermHint: Nothing showing up? System Settings → Apps → DSHA → Notifications: enable "Allow notifications"; on some phones you must also pick a "notification style / category" (e.g. banner + sound), otherwise the system silently drops them.
en.settings.alertRepeatHint: While the balance sits in a warning band, remind again after this many hours; 0 = only once when it first drops
en.settings.alertTestStale: the server is still on the old version (restart dsh to enable this button)
en.settings.dailyLimitHint: Ping the whale once today's spend across all sessions passes this (0 = off)
en.settings.dshProvidersHint: Reads the provider list from DSH (profile cordis.patch.yml on 0.1.7+, settings.yaml on older builds) and queries balances automatically. Use the switch to turn one off; switched-off ones stay off. Official-direct providers, and providers without a baseURL, are not listed here — the latter have no endpoint to query.
en.settings.modelHint: A JSON endpoint for your balance; optional API key & field paths like data.balance
en.settings.officialAutoEmpty: No provider in settings.yaml declares a baseURL, so nothing can be auto-detected
en.settings.officialHint: Comma or newline separated. Providers listed here always count as official direct connections and show their official balance; leave empty to auto-detect against the official host allowlist — only an allowlist hit counts as official, everything else is treated as a relay (including providers with no baseURL)
en.settings.overseasHint: Overseas vendors price in USD; picking USD avoids the x7 conversion error
en.settings.showBrandsHint: Show OpenAI / Claude / Gemini / Qwen / Doubao / Hunyuan / MiMo etc. (no balance API) in dashboard
en.settings.title: 哦鲸鲸 Settings
en.title: 哦鲸鲸
en.today.title: Today
en.topup.hint: Opens the platform's console / billing page. On mobile DSHA it goes through the host bridge to the system browser (the UI lives in a webview, where a plain new tab cannot open an external browser); on desktop / browsers it falls back to a new tab.
en.update.changed: The version or compatibility declaration changed. Check and confirm again.
en.update.dependencies: New or upgraded dependencies are required. Install through the host plugin manager; current version unchanged.
en.update.done: Updated. Restart Web GUI to apply
en.update.incompatible: Incompatible with this DSH; installation blocked
en.update.previewChannelHint: Preview-channel update: only newer previews on this branch, never the stable release on main ·
en.update.previewHint: Preview build: one-click update is off, so the stable line on main cannot overwrite it.
en.update.restartHint: Compatibility is checked again before installation. Restart Web GUI after updating.
en.update.title: Version & Updates
en.update.unknown: Compatibility cannot be verified; one-click installation blocked
en.valley.slogan: Night-owl deal, use AI cheap at off-peak~
en.whale.enableHint: Keep a peeking whale on the screen edge (interactive only)
en.whale.offTip: Turn on "Adopt Big Whale" above to edit these.
en.whale.snapHint: Snaps to the nearest edge on release; turn off to keep it where you drop it
en.whale.tip: Drag the whale anywhere on screen; tap once for full body and a line, tap again to tuck it back.
